answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh plume. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its relic from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the sonnet is shared, not multiplied. Seal 16upc.
